notes.title: Dec 11th Release Date
notes.notes:
🎉 Mark Your Calendars! Banana Next Gen Launches December 11th! 🍌🚀

The wait is almost over, fellow adventurers! Banana Next Gen, the wacky and action-packed 2D/3D side-scroller you've been waiting for, is set to launch on December 11th! 🗓️

Get ready to: 🍌 Soar through 15 levels of banana-fueled chaos.
💰 Collect banana coins and golden bananas to unlock exciting challenges.
👑 Face off against the ultimate foe: the Banana King, in an epic battle to save your family and friends.

Whether you’re a casual gamer or a hardcore platforming enthusiast, Banana Next Gen is here to bring a unique twist to your gaming collection. Don’t forget to add it to your wishlist and be among the first to experience this fruity adventure!

Join the countdown to launch, share your excitement, and let us know if you’re ready to become the hero your banana brethren deserve! 🍌🔥

Stay tuned for more updates and sneak peeks as we approach release day.

#BananaNextGen #IndieGame #Platformer #SteamRelease
